description: This file defines a class 'HTMLPurifier_ChildDef_Chameleon' which manages context-dependent behaviors for HTML element children, specifically for 'del' and 'ins' tags that can be either inline or block. It implements methods to initialize with inline and block definitions and validate children based on context.

classes.name: HTMLPurifier_ChildDef_Chameleon
classes.description: Manages child element definitions that vary depending on block or inline context, primarily used for 'del' and 'ins' tags.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the class with separate definitions for inline and block contexts, assigning elements from the block definition.

methods.name: validateChildren
methods.description: Validates child elements according to whether the context is inline or block, delegating to the appropriate definition.
